nodes.label: D001 Python-first backend
nodes.rationale: Python for RAG/backend, Next.js/TypeScript frontend

nodes.label: D002 RAG as reusable internal package
nodes.rationale: RAG logic under packages/rag separate from apps

nodes.label: D003 Knowledge outside RAG package
nodes.rationale: business knowledge, evals, prompts live outside packages/rag

nodes.label: D004 DocumentRepository abstraction
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 LocalDocumentRepository; Phase 2 S3DocumentRepository

nodes.label: D005 Documents are truth; chunks are derived
nodes.rationale: chunks, embeddings and indexes are derived artifacts

nodes.label: D006 Authorization during retrieval
nodes.rationale: server-created access filters applied before context construction

nodes.label: D007 Public-only Phase 1
nodes.rationale: guest/public retrieval only, metadata kept for future scopes

nodes.label: D008 Language and authorization are independent
nodes.rationale: language applicability, content language, query language and access scope stay separate

nodes.label: D009 Source precedence
nodes.rationale: owner for business policy, NAATI for CCL rules, Home Affairs for visa rules

nodes.label: D010 Qdrant primary, SQLite FTS5 fallback
nodes.rationale: authorization-preserving lexical fallback

nodes.label: D011 BGE-M3 initial embeddings
nodes.rationale: multilingual, low-cost experimentation

nodes.label: D012 Bedrock Runtime for generation
nodes.rationale: through internal generator abstraction; no Knowledge Bases/Agents/AgentCore in Phase 1

nodes.label: D013 Git/YAML prompt versioning
nodes.rationale: prompts are repo assets; Langfuse records traces

nodes.label: D014 Evaluation Suite model
nodes.rationale: goldens are one case category in a broader suite

nodes.label: D015 Human-governed LLM suggestions
nodes.rationale: LLM evaluation suggestions are candidates only

nodes.label: D016 Knowledge Release model
nodes.rationale: immutable release vs Candidate; references Document Snapshot, Evaluation Suite, RAG Config, Index Version

nodes.label: D017 Phase 2 storage direction
nodes.rationale: S3 for document bodies, metadata DB, Qdrant derived index

nodes.label: D018 Phase 2 analytics only
nodes.rationale: stable analytics event contracts now, no pipelines

nodes.label: D019 Local uv-managed Python for setup
nodes.rationale: uv cache and Python installs kept repo-local so restricted agent environments work

nodes.label: D020 Local Qdrant image pin
nodes.rationale: qdrant/qdrant:v1.19.2 with named Docker volume

nodes.label: D021 Portable spec-driven agent skills
nodes.rationale: agent-skills/ is only editable source; synced mirrors for Claude, Codex, Kiro

nodes.label: D022 Spec approval and review state live in repository
nodes.rationale: Status lines with dates; review.md; change log

nodes.label: D023 Task-gated agent workflow
nodes.rationale: per-task loop replaces whole-spec flow; independence from fresh session since a fork inherits the model

nodes.label: D024 Document repository, hashing and eligibility (Spec 002)
nodes.rationale: one explicit EligibilityPolicy; content-hash-v1 sole change signal

nodes.label: D025 persona_scope not loaded, indexed or hashed (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: access_scope is the only authorization field; closes Spec 002 F2

nodes.label: D026 Index payload rule and one version per document (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: 17-field payload; embed first then delete-and-upsert so failure keeps old points; closes Spec 002 F4

nodes.label: D027 Optional BGE-M3 dependency (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: keeps PyTorch out of make verify and CI; unit tests use the fake embedder

nodes.label: D028 Index settings mismatch refusal and rebuild by new index_version (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: store never deletes or recreates a collection

nodes.label: D029 Ingestion reads state from Qdrant (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: payload records what was indexed; no separate state store

nodes.label: D030 Baseline chunking differs from day1_baseline.yaml (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: token counting would couple chunker to tokenizer; 13 docs yield one chunk anyway

nodes.label: D031 Required retrospective that reconciles documentation
nodes.rationale: supersedes optional retrospective of D023

nodes.label: D032 Spec 004 retrospective corrections to D026 and D027
nodes.rationale: wording corrections only

nodes.label: D033 AccessContext and Role live in core (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: guest resolver returns identical GUEST_PUBLIC_POLICY object

nodes.label: D034 W2A_TENANT_ID is a server setting (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: no CLI flag or query field can set role, scope or tenant

nodes.label: D035 One filter builder, fail-closed re-check, same path for later fallbacks (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: no second policy path may be added

nodes.label: D036 Query-embedder binding is read-only and compares embedder fields only (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: chunker fields and hash_contract describe documents not queries

nodes.label: D037 Baseline result format (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: declared not verified release; random expectation min(1,k/N); never overwritten

nodes.label: D038 Embedding device recorded, not pinned (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: cross-machine reproducibility left to later work

nodes.label: D039 make lint checks formatting (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: ruff format --check; UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT default 300

nodes.label: D040 Authorization applied inside every retriever, before fusion (Spec 005 retro)
nodes.rationale: never after RRF, reranking or generation; extends D035

nodes.label: D041 Payload-derived text printed only through safe_text (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: payload text is untrusted; ZWNJ/ZWJ kept for Malayalam

nodes.label: D042 Governed suite loader, validator and schema files (Spec 006)
nodes.rationale: strict checks in validate-evaluation; loader tolerant

nodes.label: D043 Result format 2.0 for retrieval evaluation (Spec 006)
nodes.rationale: adds slices, small_sample flag, section metrics, unanswerable score distribution

nodes.label: D044 Quality gate for eval-compare (Spec 006)
nodes.rationale: constant in code, no tolerance flags; more than 1 fewer hit or MRR drop above 1/n fails

nodes.label: D045 Security gate construction (Spec 006)
nodes.rationale: throwaway in-memory collection with fake embedder; forbidden points placed at each query vector

nodes.label: D046 Legacy make retrieval-baseline stays frozen (Spec 006)
nodes.rationale: characterization test pins byte-identical output

nodes.label: D047 Security evaluation result format 1.0 (Spec 006 retro)
nodes.rationale: IDs, counts, verdicts only; default output experiments/results/tmp

nodes.label: D048 graphify knowledge graph for coding agents
nodes.rationale: developer tooling; graph is a navigation aid not truth

nodes.label: D049 Suite public-eval-v2 and the closed v1 reference (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: 91 cases; six approved Malayalam goldens g064-g069

nodes.label: D050 SQLite FTS5 lexical store, not Qdrant sparse vectors (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: stdlib, planned fallback store, no second sparse model or Qdrant schema change; ascii tokenizer because unicode61 splits Malayalam

nodes.label: D051 Tokenizer lexical-v1 (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: no stemming, stopwords or transliteration; ZWJ/ZWNJ dropped matching slugify

nodes.label: D052 Reciprocal Rank Fusion and HybridRetriever (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: fusion fails closed, no single-leg fallback

nodes.label: D053 Result format 2.1 and security result 1.1 (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: adds strategy, lexical_index, leg_ranks; gates dense, bm25, hybrid

nodes.label: D054 eval-compare identity rules (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: refuses collection, index_version, embedder, lexical identity mismatch; strategy difference allowed

nodes.label: D055 Default strategy is hybrid (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: R13 rule: gate passes, hits or MRR improve, no ml/mixed hit-to-miss

nodes.label: D056 Spec 008 taken ahead of roadmap 7 (Spec 008)
nodes.rationale: chunking gives little signal on 13 headingless docs while D055 made default depend on Qdrant, extra and lexical file

nodes.label: D057 Failure classification: one fallback-eligible error (Spec 008)
nodes.rationale: small certain eligible set; unrelated errors never become outages

nodes.label: D058 FallbackRetriever policy and worst-case latency (Spec 008)
nodes.rationale: hybrid only; no circuit breaker; ~3 s per query worst case accepted for CLIs

nodes.label: D059 Qdrant timeouts and retrieval client factory (Spec 008)
nodes.rationale: one integer timeout in qdrant-client; check_compatibility=False avoids unbounded call

nodes.label: D060 Standalone lexical open and freshness check (Spec 008)
nodes.rationale: bm25 needs neither Qdrant nor bge-m3 extra; stale or foreign files fail closed

nodes.label: D061 Result 2.2, security 1.2, served-strategy comparison (Spec 008)
nodes.rationale: mixed-path file nulls top-level strategy and latency; eval-compare refuses mixed served strategies

nodes.label: D062 Qdrant HTTP status errors not fallback-eligible (Spec 008)
nodes.rationale: a 5xx can be a server bug as well as an outage

nodes.label: DECISIONS.md architecture decision log
nodes.rationale: Durable decisions so agents do not revisit settled choices

nodes.label: rrf_fuse pure fusion function
nodes.rationale: fused = sum(weight/(k+rank)), ordered by (-fused, best rank, point_id)

nodes.label: FallbackRetriever
nodes.rationale: wraps HybridRetriever from outside so fusion stays fail-closed

nodes.label: RetrievalUnavailableError
nodes.rationale: only fallback-eligible error; reasons qdrant_unavailable, qdrant_timeout, model_unavailable

nodes.label: INGESTION_NAMESPACE
nodes.rationale: permanent; changing it changes every point ID

nodes.label: verify_fresh
nodes.rationale: asyncio.run based, cannot run in running event loop

nodes.label: circuit breaker deferred to HTTP route spec
